newsitem.title: INDIA: India I-Sec's debt market portfolio watch list.
newsitem.headline: India I-Sec's debt market portfolio watch list.

text.p: ICICI Securities and Finance Company (I-Sec) said it placed the following securities in its "portfolio watch" representing stocks that are likely to outperform the market.
Security Residual Modified Net Price Yield Weightage
Security Residual Modified Net price Yield Weightage
The portfolio is heavily weighted in favour of medium dated (3-6 years) securities.

The maturity differential spread between short dated and medium dated bonds is fairly wide and easy liquidity conditions are expected to result in a narrowing of this spread and flattening of the gilt yield curve beyond the one year tenor.
In particular, the 12.14% 2000 newly issued stock has seen strong selling pressure from Primary Dealers and is likely to appreciate over the next week or two as this selling pressures subsides.
